title: Expo apps
description: For an Expo app: no secret in EXPO_PUBLIC_ variables, local env files out of git, a runtime version for EAS Update and SDK upgrades one version at a time; builds on the react-native pack.

sources.title: Expo docs, environment variables in Expo
Expo docs, EAS Update runtime versions
Expo docs, upgrading the Expo SDK walkthrough

rules.instruction: Put no private key or other secret in an `EXPO_PUBLIC_` variable: Expo writes its value into the app bundle, where it is visible in plain text.
rules.verification: Review the `EXPO_PUBLIC_` variables the change adds, in `.env` files and in the build settings, and check that none holds a secret.

rules.instruction: Add `.env*.local` to `.gitignore` so that the machine-specific `.env.local` files stay out of version control; commit only the default `.env` files the team shares.
rules.verification: task verify checks that a `.gitignore` lists `.env*.local`; also check that the change commits no `.env.local` file.

rules.instruction: When the app ships updates with EAS Update, set `runtimeVersion` in the app config, as a value or as a policy such as `fingerprint`, and change it whenever the native code changes, so that an update never reaches a build whose native code it does not match.
rules.verification: Check the `runtimeVersion` of the app config, and for a change to native code or native dependencies, that the runtime version changes with it or that the fingerprint policy computes it.

rules.instruction: Upgrade the Expo SDK one version at a time: install the next `expo` version, run `npx expo install --fix` to align the dependencies with it, then `npx expo-doctor`.
rules.verification: Check that the change moves `expo` by one SDK version and that `npx expo-doctor` reports no problem.
